discovered_skills.name: research-observatory:research-goal
discovered_skills.description: Clarify an unclear research commission through focused interviews, produce a long-term goal prompt, and continue or resume an authorized study using Research State CLI or WebMCP. Use for research scoping and goal design, not a routine status or scene request.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify research goals, evidence and reporting
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $research-goal to turn my research request into a long-term goal.

research_laya_resolve.name: research_laya_resolve
research_laya_resolve.description: Bind an external Laya response to candidate IDs and return an unverified proposal; no model call or automatic adoption. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_resource.name: research_resource
research_resource.description: Append a sourced external cost/token observation, with unknown gaps and no independent certification. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_restore.name: research_restore
research_restore.description: Restore an archive under the configured root into an empty workspace; restoration never executes an experiment. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_hypothesis.name: research_hypothesis
research_hypothesis.description: Record a proposed hypothesis. Optional expect rejects a stale workspace revision. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_goal_close.name: research_goal_close
research_goal_close.description: Record a research completion/pause/cancellation report. It does not certify science or stop any worker. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_init.name: research_init
research_init.description: Initialize a research workspace; private local capability contents are not returned. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_memory.name: research_memory
research_memory.description: Search paginated research summaries by literal substring and outcome; claim verification is explicit. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_resource_show.name: research_resource_show
research_resource_show.description: Read paginated original observations and currency-separated observed subtotals; full research cost remains unknown. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_verify.name: research_verify
research_verify.description: Run the owner's frozen validator on actual evidence and registered criteria; agent numbers cannot certify success. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_status.name: research_status
research_status.description: Read paginated state, currently allowed operations, and missing evidence without scientific ranking. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_goal_show.name: research_goal_show
research_goal_show.description: Read the goal's current version, lifecycle, paginated history and external resource observations. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_export.name: research_export
research_export.description: Create a consistent, hashed archive at a relative workspace path; existing output is not overwritten. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_goal.name: research_goal
research_goal.description: Record an externally chosen research objective. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_evidence.name: research_evidence
research_evidence.description: Append an unverified claim and optional evidence file relative to the workspace; this never certifies an experiment. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_help.name: research_help
research_help.description: Read command help or a public preregistration/Laya JSON example. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_laya_prepare.name: research_laya_prepare
research_laya_prepare.description: Return candidates, conditions, evidence, and a bound Laya request. The external agent saves the digest and runs Laya. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_goal_amend.name: research_goal_amend
research_goal_amend.description: Append an explicit meaning/scope/plan version; frozen experiment criteria and original goal versions remain immutable. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_register.name: research_register
research_register.description:
Freeze conditions and success criteria before execution. Use research_help(topic='register') for spec.

        Criteria cannot be overwritten after registration. A changed experiment needs a new registration.
        A local owner must first register the fixed validator using the CLI. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_run.name: research_run
research_run.description:
Execute a preregistered local experiment once it is claimed; repeated requests reuse known state.

        Unknown execution is not automatically rerun. This does not guarantee exactly-once external side effects.
        Default output summarizes evidence; full includes original execution receipts and details. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_recover.name: research_recover
research_recover.description: Collect a surviving worker's receipt after interruption, or report unknown; never launch a replacement run. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_decide.name: research_decide
research_decide.description: Record the external agent's decision; adoption requires successful execution and valid independently verified evidence. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_show.name: research_show
research_show.description: Read a complete registration, original evidence links, current integrity, and verification/decision states. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

research_goal_resume.name: research_goal_resume
research_goal_resume.description: Reactivate the same goal; never create a replacement goal or launch an experiment. This tool is part of plugin `Research Observatory`.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $research-goal to turn my research request into a long-term goal.

skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex.
skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OpenAI Docs for official docs lookup, questions about Codex itself or Codex surfaces, model selection, model migration, and prompt-upgrade work.

skills.name: review-agent
skills.description: Perform a read-only, defect-first review of a specified code change and return every actionable finding. Use when another agent delegates review of uncommitted changes, a base-branch diff, a commit, or custom review instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Find actionable bugs in code changes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.description: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos).
skills.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos

interface.shortDescription: Install curated skills from openai/skills or other repos
